Workshop 5: Human vs. AI Transcription Reconciliation

Overview: In this workshop, you will reconcile your Week 4 manual diplomatic transcription (witness.xml) against your Gemini AI transcription (transcription_ai.xml) generated in VS Code Antigravity. Using VS Code's side-by-side diff viewer, you will adjudicate every discrepancy line by line, evaluate readings against your primary manuscript image, synthesize an authoritative consensus file (transcription_reconciled.xml) validating to 0 schema errors, and write an audit reflection report (RECONCILIATION.md).

Deadlines: Initial Submission due Friday by 11:00 PM; Peer Feedback due Monday by 11:00 PM.
